# Featured Article

`editorial/featured-article` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

The lead story: a large image, category, a big title, excerpt, byline and a read button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article` | article |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Image on top, text beneath.
- **split**: Image beside the text. Sets `layout: split`.
- **centered**: Image on top with centered text. Sets `align: center`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `stacked`, `split` | `"stacked"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `linkLabel` | text | `"Read the full story"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and images honored. Split is a table row. | Fine. The split variant stacks on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/featured-article', {
  "article": {
    "title": "The last shirt you will need to buy this summer",
    "excerpt": "We spent two years perfecting one linen shirt. Here is what we learned, from the flax field to the final stitch.",
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/600x340/png?text=Feature",
      "alt": "A linen shirt in sand hanging in a sunlit window"
    },
    "href": "https://example.com/journal/the-last-shirt",
    "author": "Maya Chen",
    "date": "14 June",
    "category": "Feature",
    "readTime": "8 min read"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/featured-article",
  "data": {
    "article": {
      "title": "The last shirt you will need to buy this summer",
      "excerpt": "We spent two years perfecting one linen shirt. Here is what we learned, from the flax field to the final stitch.",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/600x340/png?text=Feature",
        "alt": "A linen shirt in sand hanging in a sunlit window"
      },

    }
```
